The text further clarifies that 'only the base level R_{0,0} is learnable, while other levels are derived from it'. This confirms that the first column (where j=0) is filled vertically (using i-1, i.e., from the previous row) and subsequent columns (j>0) are filled horizontally (using j-1, i.e., from the column to the left).
